Monologue: Pardon my intrusion, friend, but won't you mind waiting a little longer before closing?
We have much to speak of. Would be a shame to delay our inevitable meeting any longer.
I understand you are not much of a socialite, so I'll ask my questions and be on my way.
Do you feel like you have made a mistake?
As if there could be more to those around you?
They would have enjoyed their time with you, my friend. Returning like the others with hope of another good meal.
You should savor what you have left.
You never know when more might disappear.
